author: Gundham
body:
Thanks to alexanderjoe10 for supplying server! <3

«§» CTW: Nucleus «§»



Hey guys! It's MonsieurGray here, previously known as Evocal, and MonsieurStar, previously known as HotCamTheMan, bringing our first group build map, [CTW] Nucleus!

Basically I have combined Justice II, Justice III, Alpha Complex, Sector Six and Formorgar to create this... nice map? I hope you guys like it and don't forget to leave feedback below <3

Nucleus is a CTW map for Avicus that has the following features:
- Iron Farm above Teamspawns
- Iron Farm below battlefields
- Cobwebs, soulsand, sugar canes, and other things that might annoy you here and there
- Special items at the top/inside of the towers (Bows and Swords)
- Three Wool Rooms with some treasure!
- Portals, both in and out!
- Beacons scattered around the map

So... as I previously mentioned, I love shattering your dreams to the most tiny expression ever!

CTW is *NOT* confirmed, but possible.

There! Said that, I'll allow you to take a look at the pictures I've taken of this map:

Oh... the might wool room!
